description: Provincial Public Service Commission Western Provincial - Amendment No. 4 - Western Provincial Public Management Assistant Service Minute
categorisation: This gazette notification amends the service minute for the Western Provincial Public Management Assistant Service, specifically changing the service name and titles. This involves public service administration and classification matters within the provincial public service commission, which falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) as it deals with public service structure and nomenclature rather than government personnel changes or organizational restructuring of ministries/departments.
